_about: The password rule as the server applies it (business_app/utils/validators.py PasswordValidator), for the two test suites that check the sign-up and reset checklist against it. tests/integration/test_web_auth_forms.py proves every verdict here is the server's (requirements() and unmet_requirements(), and POST /api/v1/auth/register); admin_ui/src/__tests__/web/authForms.test.js proves the real auth-form.js ticks every rule exactly when `ticks_all` says so. `accepted` is false for a password that meets every rule but is on the server's too-common list.
